mapper.select: SELECT id FROM question WHERE source_ref = #{sourceRef} LIMIT 1

SELECT q.id, q.question_type, q.current_version_id, q.current_version_no, q.edited_manual, q.stem_html, q.analysis_html, q.correct, q.answer_text, q.assets_json, q.source_ref, q.source_name, q.source_year, q.source_question_no, s.name AS subject_name FROM question q LEFT JOIN subject s ON s.id = q.subject_id WHERE q.id = #{id} LIMIT 1
SELECT current_version_no FROM question WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE

SELECT id AS version_id, question_id, version_no, edit_source, stem_html, analysis_html, correct, answer_text, assets_json, source_ref, source_name, source_year, source_question_no, content_sha256, base_version_id, edit_note, created_at FROM question_version WHERE question_id = #{questionId} AND version_no = #{versionNo} LIMIT 1

SELECT version_no, edit_source, content_sha256, base_version_id, edit_note, created_at, CHAR_LENGTH(stem_html) AS stem_chars, (analysis_html IS NULL) AS analysis_absent FROM question_version WHERE question_id = #{questionId} ORDER BY version_no
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO question_version (question_id, version_no, edit_source, stem_html, analysis_html, correct, answer_text, assets_json, source_ref, source_name, source_year, source_question_no, content_sha256, base_version_id, edit_note) VALUES (#{v.question_id}, #{v.version_no}, #{v.edit_source}, #{v.stem_html}, #{v.analysis_html}, #{v.correct}, #{v.answer_text}, #{v.assets_json}, #{v.source_ref}, #{v.source_name}, #{v.source_year}, #{v.source_question_no}, #{v.content_sha256}, #{v.base_version_id}, #{v.edit_note})
mapper.update: UPDATE question SET stem_html = #{stemHtml}, analysis_html = #{analysisHtml}, correct = #{correct}, answer_text = #{answerText}, current_version_id = #{versionId}, current_version_no = #{versionNo}, edited_manual = 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND current_version_no = (SELECT current_version_no FROM (SELECT current_version_no FROM question WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE) cur)
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO answer_bind (bind_token, question_id, version_id, version_no, status) VALUES (#{token}, #{questionId}, #{versionId}, #{versionNo}, 'active')
mapper.select: SELECT b.id, b.bind_token, b.question_id, b.version_id, b.version_no, b.status, b.answer_text, b.bound_at, b.submitted_at, v.stem_html, v.analysis_html, v.correct, q.source_ref, q.source_year, q.source_question_no, s.name AS subject_name FROM answer_bind b JOIN question_version v ON v.id = b.version_id JOIN question q ON q.id = b.question_id LEFT JOIN subject s ON s.id = q.subject_id WHERE b.bind_token = #{token} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE answer_bind SET status = 'submitted', answer_text = #{answerText}, submitted_at = NOW() WHERE bind_token = #{token} AND status = 'active'
